Every Tesira / TesiraFORTÉ DSP that runs Tesira software shares the same TTP protocol. Driver covers the block types AV integrators commonly use for room control. Setup: in Tesira's System Manager → Network Settings, enable Discovery and Telnet (both default OFF). Leave System Security disabled for the no-credentials path used by this driver.

Every Q-SYS Core that runs Q-SYS Designer software supports QRC. The driver speaks QRC (TCP 1710), not the legacy ECP (TCP 1702) — make sure the Core's Q-SYS firmware supports QRC (any version since Q-SYS 5.x). Setup: open your design in Q-SYS Designer, find the Code Names of the Components, Named Controls, Mixers, Routers, and Snapshots you want to control, then declare them in the block list below.
